messages.welcome:
Hi! I'm *Rockwell*, your Prudential Virtual Assistant.

For more on Annuities, please choose a topic. Or in a few words, you can type a question too.<hr class='linebreak' />_By using this chatbot, you agree to Prudential's policies on the use of your data to further improve the experience. See our [Privacy Center](https://pru.us/PrivacyAnnRW) for more information._

All of your Prudential tax forms will be mailed to you within 5 business days.

To begin, *enter your full contract number* with all the letters and numbers (like E0123456).<hr class='linebreak' />• _If you need to find your contract number, log in to your [Account](https://pru.us/AccountAnnRW). • _To view your mailing address, go to [My Profile](https://pru.us/ProfileAnnRW) from your online account. Any updates should be made before you request your tax forms._
